title: The second chair, carried out
logline: A folding chair being carried out onto the dock at dusk by a thin man in plaid from behind, toward the lawn chair, four days before the two chairs. The page shows who carries it and not who it's for.

panels.composition: A thin man in plaid from behind carrying a folding chair out onto a dock at dusk toward an old lawn chair, string lights lit along the shack's eave.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a thin man in plaid flannel seen from behind carrying a folding chair out onto a wooden dock at dusk toward an old lawn chair, colored string lights lit along a shingle shack's eave, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Who carries it; not who it's for.
